主要内容: On April 1, 2013, PACIFICHEALTH LABORATORIES, INC. completed an offering to a small group of investors, issuing 123.77 shares of its newly authorized Series A Preferred Stock and warrants to purchase 4,331,950 shares of its common stock at $0.10 per share. The company raised $866,390 through the sale of Series A shares priced at $7,000 each, convertible into 12,377,000 common shares. The offering was exempt from registration under the Securities Act of 1933. Proceeds will fund marketing of BODY GLOVE SURGE™, launched in late 2012, and a new product in Q2 2013. The company filed Form 15 to terminate reporting obligations under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 on April 1, 2013, with 90 record holders of common stock.
